europe_now.title: EU Prosecutors Maintain Inquiries into von der Leyen Over Pfizergate
europe_now.summary: European prosecutors are continuing their inquiries regarding European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen over the procurement of coronavirus vaccines. The outgoing chief of the European Public Prosecutor's Office raised concerns regarding the institutional backing of the agency.

europe_now.title: Poland Designated to Host Patriot Missile Service Facility
europe_now.summary: United States authorities have selected Poland to host a dedicated service facility for Patriot missile systems. This development strengthens regional defense infrastructure within Central Europe.

top_stories.title: European Union Resource Strategy and Australia Partnerships
top_stories.summary: The European Union is planning significant investments in Australian critical minerals to reduce strategic reliance on China. These measures form part of broader European efforts to enhance external trade and resource security.

top_stories.title: Diplomatic Outreach and Regional Security Concerns
top_stories.summary: Finnish President Stubb engaged in a lengthy telephone discussion with the Kremlin, aiming to address ongoing security concerns. This diplomatic contact has reportedly sparked a distinct rift with Danish officials.
